objective: Improve exact-printing hold/self-sale/buylist decisions through corroborated signals rather than more undifferentiated price columns

priorities.implementation: Append snapshots; retain seller count if exposed, offered quantities, delivered asks, sales dates and native transaction identifiers if available. Deduplicate overlapping recent-sale windows; inventory disappearance alone is not a sale.
priorities.interpretation: Rising comparable sale prices plus thinning supply supports a patient test. Rising asks alone do not.

priorities.signal: Dealer urgency and relative bid strength
priorities.implementation: Preserve dealer price, wanted quantity, observation date, refresh provenance and exact variant scope independently.
priorities.interpretation: Bid above ordinary self-sale net with adequate capacity is a buylist opportunity. Rising bid and shrinking wanted quantity can flag a closing exit; not proof of sales.

priorities.signal: Collector premium supported by completed sales
priorities.implementation: Target high-value/special treatments; actual accepted Best Offer prices, shipping, lot size, language, condition; separate auctions and fixed-price outcomes. eBay Seller Hub access required; bulk API/automation not established.
priorities.interpretation: Repeated premium over ordinary printing with worthwhile net dollars supports self-sale or specialist quotes.

priorities.implementation: Oracle-card context separate from printing identity; use inclusion share with denominators and comparable windows; no independent-vote double counting for sites sharing underlying price data.
priorities.interpretation: Growing play interest can explain a durable demand shift when exact-product transactions and supply corroborate it.

sources: Wizards official announcements and card galleries
priorities.implementation: Timestamp confirmed reprints/releases/bans and identify functional substitute versus same collector treatment. Treat rumor as research lead, never confirmed event.
priorities.interpretation: Hold needs positive forward evidence, not merely a past high. Reprint of ordinary copies may affect play demand pricing differently from special treatment premium.

priorities.implementation: Exact scope/cash-equivalent proceeds after cashout/transaction/shipping charges; distinguish index from funded offer. Confirm quantity and buyer-specific event availability.
priorities.interpretation: Adds competitive exit options, especially specialist demand, without assuming index value is obtainable cash.

access_limits: eBay is a potential targeted resource: authenticated Seller Hub pilot captured privately; historical Marketplace Insights API closed to new users; bulk ingestion/export not established. Pilot listing aggregates and unresolved comparable scope are not accepted canonical sales. Cardsphere index starts from NM English and models other languages/conditions, so use exact offers rather than treating its index as an independent exact-language valuation. MTGJSON AllPrices supplies a rolling 90-day window; durable longer history requires retaining dated observations. MTGStocks blocked research crawler. No new accepted market observations or recurring schedule created by this research.
synthesis_rules: Count independent upstream evidence, not the number of websites repeating it.
Separate executable cash bids, completed sales, asking prices, derived reference indices and play-interest proxies.
Compare USD US-market evidence with exact printing, finish, language and grade scope; retain unmatched candidates outside accepted valuations.
Store observed date separately from capture date, plus source, original identity, units, shipping, time window, filters and sample completeness.
Preserve conflicts; explain their economic implications instead of averaging unlike measures.
Dealer capacity must cover the proposed quantity; shared product capacity must not be allocated twice.
Use repeated comparable sales and supply evidence to assess higher-price opportunities; compare worthwhile net dollars after costs.
Hold requires a positive forward case and a condition for reassessment; past highs alone do not justify it.
